records.title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
records.reason: AutoViewMem self-configures orthogonal memory views to reduce semantic interference in top-K retrieval for conversational long-term memory; an agent memory representation method, adjacent to inference-time retrieval but not a serving contribution, hence borderline.

records.title: AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations - Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control
records.reason: AMU controls memory admission and updates for personalized conversations using structured memory with a small-model guided controller; a memory write-path governance method for assistants, not an inference system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips
records.reason: Real HBM2 chips are experimentally characterized to build accurate power models and expose data-pattern-dependent consumption; memory-hardware measurement relevant to inference infrastructure, but a characterization study without an inference mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to EEG analysis and decoding via an autonomous research framework, a brain-signal application, with no LLM inference subject stated in the title.

records.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
records.reason: EvoMemState maintains evolving memory state for personal LLM agents so new facts update and constrain earlier ones instead of sitting as independent facts; an agent memory consistency method without serving or decoding content, so borderline.

records.title: Attention Is Not All You Need Anymore
records.reason: A family of drop-in self-attention replacements aims to preserve transformer performance while changing the attention computation; an architecture proposal whose abstract centers on performance retention rather than demonstrated LLM inference gains, so borderline.

records.title: Translational Equivariance in Kernelizable Attention
records.reason: Kernelizable attention is given translational equivariance so relative-position inductive biases survive without materializing the full attention matrix; efficient-attention theory with an inference-relevant motivation but no LLM inference evaluation, hence borderline.

records.title: Portus: Efficient DNN Checkpointing to Persistent Memory with Zero-Copy
records.reason: Portus checkpoints DNN models from GPUs to persistent memory over RDMA with a zero-copy three-level index; training checkpoint infrastructure, not inference serving or execution.

records.title: On Pretraining for Project-Level Code Completion
records.reason: Repository-level pretraining strategies and a 16K context extension are studied for project-level code completion with OpenCoder; a pretraining study for a coding capability, not inference.

records.title: EvoMem: Improving Multi-Agent Planning with Dual-Evolving Memory
records.reason: EvoMem gives LLM multi-agent planning frameworks dual-evolving memory inspired by working memory; an agent planning memory method whose contribution is coordination quality, not inference systems, so borderline.

records.title: QwT-v2: Practical, Effective and Efficient Post-Training Quantization
records.reason: QwT-v2 improves post-training quantization with lightweight compensating structures while removing the extra latency and incompatibility of the original QwT; a practical quantization contribution directly reducing model inference resource use, hence accept.

records.title: LongT5-Mulla: LongT5 With Multi-Level Local Attention for a Longer Sequence
records.reason: LongT5-Mulla adds multi-level local attention so LongT5 handles longer sequences than full quadratic attention allows; an efficient-attention architecture variant for long-text tasks, but an older model-line study without LLM serving evidence, so borderline.

records.title: The Curious Case of Factuality Finetuning: Models' Internal Beliefs Can Improve Factuality
records.reason: Factuality finetuning is studied through models' internal beliefs to reduce hallucination with the right training data; a training-data study for output factuality with no inference contribution.

records.title: Synthetic bootstrapped pretraining
records.reason: Synthetic bootstrapped pretraining learns inter-document relations to synthesize a new corpus for joint LM pretraining; a pretraining data method with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Affinitention nets: kernel perspective on attention architectures for set classification with applications to medical text and images
records.reason: Affinitention nets give a kernel view of attention for set classification, applied to pathology slides and medical text; a medical/vision set-classification method with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Small Character Models Match Large Word Models for Autocomplete Under Memory Constraints
records.reason: Small character-level models match large word models for open-domain autocomplete under explicit memory constraints; model sizing under memory limits is inference-adjacent, but the study is a task comparison rather than an inference mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Attention is All You Need Until You Need Retention
records.reason: A retention layer gives transformers persistent memory read by attention and written during use, reframed as social learning over other agents' behavior; a speculative architecture/memory proposal without an inference-system evaluation, hence borderline.

records.title: GPT-C: Generative PrompT Compression
records.reason: GPT-C generatively compresses long prompts to accelerate LLM inference and relieve context-window limits while preserving task performance; a direct prompt-compression contribution to inference cost, hence accept.

records.title: Accelerating Parallel Structures in DNNs via Parallel Fusion and Operator Co-Optimization
records.reason: Magneto is an ML compiler that broadens parallel fusion scope and co-optimizes operators to accelerate DNN inference; compiler-level inference optimization, but demonstrated for generic DNN structures rather than LLM serving, so borderline.

records.title: The curious case of developmental BERTology: On sparsity, transfer learning, generalization and the brain
records.reason: This essay connects developmental neuroscience with sparsity, transfer learning and generalization in BERT-era models; a perspective piece with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: ACME: Adaptive Customization of Large Models via Distributed Systems
records.reason: ACME adaptively customizes large transformer models for deployment closer to users under privacy, latency and energy constraints in distributed systems; deployment customization framework adjacent to serving, but centered on automated model design rather than inference execution, so borderline.

records.title: StretchySnake: Flexible SSM Training Unlocks Action Recognition Across Spatio-Temporal Scales
records.reason: StretchySnake adapts SSM training to multiple spatio-temporal resolutions for video action recognition; a training method for a video application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Compute-Adaptive Risk Control: A Finite-Sample Calibration Layer for Early-Exit and Cascade Inference
records.reason: Compute-adaptive risk control calibrates policy selection among early-exit and cascade inference policies with finite-sample guarantees; it governs adaptive inference policies, but the contribution is a statistical calibration layer rather than an inference mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Wainscot: Tailoring Model Parallelism to Fit Device Memory Limits
records.reason: Wainscot rebalances model-parallel allocations so training a large DNN fits device memory limits without idle devices; a training memory/parallelism method, not inference.

records.title: Localized Spatial-State Enhanced Decoder for Infrared Small Target Detection
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to a decoder for infrared small target detection, a remote-sensing detection application, with no language-model inference subject in the title.

records.title: AttentionLib: A Scalable Optimization Framework for Automated Attention Acceleration on FPGA
records.reason: AttentionLib automatically optimizes and accelerates self-attention on FPGAs, explicitly targeting the memory-intensive decode phase of long-sequence LLM inference; a direct attention-acceleration contribution for LLM inference, hence accept.

records.title: CNN with large memory layers
records.reason: Product-key memory layers give CNNs sparse access to very large memory with square-root scaling, demonstrated on computer vision; a vision memory architecture with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Fast Training of NMT Model with Data Sorting
records.reason: Sorting translation sentences by length removes empty-token computation when training transformer NMT models; a training efficiency trick for one application, not inference.

records.title: Kernel Approximation using Analog In-Memory Computing
records.reason: Analog in-memory computing approximates kernel functions for classical ML algorithms directly in memory arrays; hardware for kernel methods outside transformer/LLM inference, with only generic proximity to inference acceleration, so borderline.

records.title: Stereo sound event localization and detection based on PSELDnet pretraining and BiMamba sequence modeling
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to stereo sound event localization and detection, an audio-scene application, with no language-model inference subject stated in the title.

records.title: Grounded AI for Code Review: Resource-Efficient Large-Model Serving in Enterprise Pipelines
records.reason: A production code-review system serves a quantized open-weight model on a single GPU with multi-tier caching inside enterprise pipelines; a real serving deployment, but the contribution is an application pipeline rather than a reusable inference mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification Methods for Large Language Models with LM-Polygraph
records.reason: LM-Polygraph benchmarks uncertainty quantification methods for detecting LLM hallucinations; an evaluation framework for output reliability with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Selective State-Space Adaptation and Retrieval for Language Model Reasoning
records.reason: MaLoRA makes LoRA adapter scaling input-dependent through selective state-space control for language model reasoning; an adapter architecture for capability, trained per task, with no inference efficiency or serving contribution.

records.title: Provably Learning from Modern Language Models via Low Logit Rank
records.reason: Modern language models are argued to be learnable because their conditional log-probability matrices have approximately low logit rank; a learning-theory result with no inference-system content.

records.title: Adaptive agentic meta-controller (AAMC): A deep reinforcement learning framework for intelligent SLM/LLM orchestration
records.reason: AAMC is a deep RL meta-controller orchestrating small and large language models in agentic systems to cut cost and latency; orchestration policy for agent workloads is serving-adjacent, but presented as an RL controller study rather than a serving system, so borderline.

records.title: HyPAC: Cost-Efficient LLMs-Human Hybrid Annotation with PAC Error Guarantees
records.reason: HyPAC adaptively routes annotation inputs among LLMs, reasoning models and human experts with PAC error guarantees at lowest cost; cost-aware routing for an annotation application, adjacent to inference routing but not an LLM serving mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Think Short, Defer Smart, Act, and Repeat: Calibrated Reasoning and Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for Edge LLM Agents
records.reason: Think Short, Defer Smart manages reasoning budgets for edge LLM agents and defers to a cloud model under calibrated uncertainty; edge-cloud deferral is inference-relevant, but the contribution is an agent reliability framework rather than a serving mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: Compact Constraint Encoding for LLM Code Generation: An Empirical Study of Token Economics and Constraint Compliance
records.reason: Compact structured constraint headers are empirically shown to reduce prompt token consumption for LLM code generation across 11 models; token-economics measurement for one application, with no reusable compression mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: FLARE: Fine-Grained Diagnostic Feedback for LLM Code Refinement
records.reason: FLARE uses a lightweight diagnostic model to give line-level bug localization feedback for iterative LLM code refinement; a code-generation application framework with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: A Survey of Deep Learning Approaches for OCR and Document Understanding
records.reason: This survey reviews deep learning for OCR and document understanding across invoices, contracts and resumes; a document-processing survey unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: DLM-DTI: a dual language model for the prediction of drug-target interaction with hint-based learning
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to prediction of drug-target interaction with a dual language model, a pharmaceutical application, with no inference-system subject in the title.

records.reason: VideoAgent2 enhances an LLM agent system for long-form video understanding with uncertainty-aware chain of thought; a video-understanding application framework with no inference-system contribution.

records.reason: Title explicitly presents a systematic discussion of robots using LLMs for healthcare, a medical-robotics application topic, with no inference-system subject stated in the title.

records.reason: CodeTF is an open-source library unifying data, model and training/inference pipelines for code LLMs; developer tooling for code intelligence rather than an inference-system contribution.
